ForumIAS is organizing an exclusive session as part of the MGP Strategy Series with Monika Srivastava (AIR 16, UPSC CSE 2025) , who secured an outstanding 129 marks in GS Paper 2 . The session will be organised in Online mode only.
Here is the e-Meet link: https://go.forumias.com/gs2-8june8pm

GS Paper 2 is often considered one of the most dynamic papers in UPSC Mains, requiring a strong blend of conceptual clarity, current affairs integration, analytical thinking, and answer-writing skills. In this session, Monika Srivastava will share her preparation strategy and the approach that helped her achieve a high score in GS Paper 2.
